Install all report-module dependencies

Source: R/module-dependencies.R
install_all.Rd

Automatically discover packages required to render reports and dependencies declared by active report modules, then install them with pak::pkg_install(). Module dependencies are read from the packages option in each module's R Markdown code block.

Usage

install_all(
  package_references = NULL,
  lib = NULL,
  upgrade = FALSE,
  ask = interactive()
)

Arguments

package_references

An optional character vector of pak package references. A named element replaces the corresponding discovered package name; an unnamed element is added to the installation request.

lib

An optional character vector of library paths passed to pak::pkg_install().

upgrade

A logical value. If TRUE, update the requested packages and their dependencies. The default is FALSE.

ask

A logical value controlling confirmation before replacing an installed package version. The default is interactive().

Value

Invisibly returns the result from pak::pkg_install(), or NULL when no dependencies are declared.

Details

install_all() scans both the module registry bundled with camtrapReport and every user-managed registry previously used with add_Module(). Module directories are registered automatically when they are used, so no path is required when calling install_all(). The discovered package names are passed to pak::pkg_install(). package_references can provide the source of a package that cannot be resolved by name from a configured repository. For example, c(myPackage = "owner/myPackage") replaces the discovered package name with its GitHub package reference.

See also

add_Module(), list_Modules(), reportSection()

Other report modules: modules

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  install_all()

  install_all(
    package_references = c(
      camtrapDensity = "MarcusRowcliffe/camtrapDensity"
    )
  )
}
